name: ScoutAgent
description: ScoutAgent Terverifikasi is a verification-first AI agent on the Concordium testnet. It sells a micro-service to other agents - a curated digest of Web3 bounty and hackathon opportunities - and is built so nobody has to trust its word, and it never has to trust a stranger's either. Its identity is an on-chain fact: registered in the Concordium Agent Registry (CIS-8004), its Agent Card is pinned by SHA-256 hash and its "Verified by Concordium" badge is the address of its registry NFT. Before paying, any client resolves the badge: the agent must be registered, Active, and the served card must hash-match the on-chain value. The gate runs both ways: before ScoutAgent works, the client must pass the same badge check plus a Web3ID zero-knowledge proof (e.g. over-18) that reveals no document. Every check, payment and task is written to an audit log whose digests can be anchored on-chain.
